test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The tribesmen cautiously came _______ to collect the items left by the officials.
solution:
The correct answer is **forward**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Forward:** Towards the direction one is looking or moving.
 
• **Preposition of Direction: **They indicate a direction in which a particular work is to be done. It gives us an idea where something is directed.
 
 
• Example: Forward, Ahead, Afar, etc.
 
 
 
• In this question, 'came' is immediately followed by 'forward', which together means **'volunteered'**.
 
• Thus, in this sentence tribesmen took / initiated a step forward to collect the items left by the officials.

 Hence, the correct sentence is:** **The tribesmen cautiously came** ****​f**orward to collect the items left by the officials.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Let us see the meaning of other 3 prepositions:
 
 
• **After:** following in space, time or order
 
• **Afar:** When someone or something is at a distance.
 
• **Ahead:** in front or further along
